subject.title: fix: include pnpm 11 bins in gateway PATH

question: Should this PR land with generated service PATH user and package-manager directories ordered after trusted system dirs while adding pnpm 11 and npm global bin candidates?
rationale: The implementation is focused and security-conscious, but service PATH precedence is upgrade-visible and should be explicitly owned before merge.

options.title: Land Hardened PATH Order
options.body: Keep the current diff and accept that managed services will prefer trusted system dirs before user/package-manager dirs after regeneration.

options.title: Require Live Install Refresh Proof
options.body: Ask for a Linux user-systemd openclaw gateway install --force transcript on this head before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Inclusion Only
options.body: Rework the branch to add missing pnpm/npm bin candidates without changing generated service PATH precedence.

recommendation.title: Land Hardened PATH Order
recommendation.body: Keep the current diff and accept that managed services will prefer trusted system dirs before user/package-manager dirs after regeneration.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the PR and authored the latest security-hardening commit that shapes the compatibility tradeoff.
